provider_id: llm-coder (scratch benchmark container, not the compose-managed service)

config.launch_method: scratch `docker run --rm` using the pinned image digest directly, port 8093, no live .env.models / compose.models.yml edits; normal llm-coder compose service was stopped first (docker compose --profile coder stop llm-coder) to free VRAM for the single-heavy-model policy

observed.confirmed_cli_args: docker inspect Config.Cmd verified: -m ... --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --flash-attn on alongside -c 8192

comparison_to_baseline.note: At 8192 tokens the f16 KV cache is already small in absolute terms, so the absolute VRAM saved by halving it is modest (+354 MiB free) even though the KV buffer itself roughly halved. This is far short of the ADR-004 1 GiB safety-margin policy threshold on its own.

smoke_test.method: direct curl to the scratch container's own OpenAI-compatible endpoint (127.0.0.1:8093/v1/chat/completions), using the exact same request bodies as scripts/ai opencode test's internal probes (temperature=0, 'Reply with the single word pong.', and a get_time(timezone) tool-call probe)
smoke_test.deviation_note: Not routed through LiteLLM :4000 / the host gateway :8888, because those only ever address the live-managed llm-coder container on its normal port/name; redirecting them to a scratch container would require editing live gateway routing config, which is out of scope. Direct-to-engine curl against the OpenAI-compatible endpoint exercises the same server code path (grammar-constrained tool calling, chat template) and is a reasonable substitute for this scratch-only benchmark.
smoke_test.tool_call_result: tool_calls[0].function.name='get_time', arguments='{"timezone":"UTC"}' (finish_reason=tool_calls) -- structurally correct, matches baseline behavior

notes: cache-type-k/v q8_0 confirmed supported by the exact pinned image via `docker run ... --help` (see docs/research/TECHNOLOGY_EVALUATION_MATRIX.md 2026-08-19 addendum).
No quality regression observed in this smoke test (structurally correct tool_calls, coherent short reply), consistent with community reports that q8_0/q8_0 KV cache is near-lossless.
This does not by itself justify raising context: see coder-quantkv-c12288-q8_0.json / decision in ADR-011 for whether the freed headroom was enough to safely go further.
